subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Determined
solution:
The correct answer is: **Decisive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"determined"** means having made a firm decision and being resolved not to change it. (दृढ़ निश्चयी)

 
 
• **Example: **She was determined to finish the marathon despite the pain.
 
 
 
• **"Decisive"** refers to having or showing the ability to make decisions quickly and effectively. (निर्णायक)
 
 
• **Example: **His decisive leadership helped the team win the project.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'determined' **is **'decisive'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Decisive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Flexible** (लचीला): Willing to change or compromise.

 
 
• **Example:** She has a flexible schedule and can meet us at any time.
 
 
 
• **Famous** (प्रसिद्ध): Known about by many people.
 
 
• **Example:** He became famous for his groundbreaking research.
 
 
 
• **Elevated** (ऊँचा): Raised to a higher level or position.
 
 
• **Example:** The house is elevated on a hill, offering stunning views.
